title: plectranthus australis var. vulgaris
intro: Plectranthus australis var. vulgaris, commonly known as Australian Coleus or Spotted Coleus, is a flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to help reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus australis var. vulgaris are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, that have antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being.
